plan.description: Read-only architect for the Document Translation Platform. Before planning, explore relevant docs from docs/architecture/ and docs/frontend/. Produces structured plans with file paths, module responsibilities, and phase compliance. After plan, prompt user to switch to build mode.

build.description: Implements approved plans for the Document Translation Platform. Delegates coding to backend-builder and frontend-builder subagents. After code, always launches convention-reviewer, test-author, and docs-writer. Never skips review, tests, or docs steps.

explore.description: Reads and synthesizes the Document Translation Platform codebase and documentation. For documentation research, load the quick-reference tables from fastapi-backend and frontend-app skills to know which docs to read.

feature.description: Build a feature end-to-end: research -> code -> review -> test -> docs
feature.template: Implement the following feature following the full workflow (backend-builder, frontend-builder, convention-reviewer, test-author, docs-writer): $ARGS

review.description: Review current changes against all project conventions
review.template: Audit all unstaged and staged changes against project conventions

docs.description: Generate or update documentation for recent code changes
docs.template: Update all project documentation to reflect recent code changes. $ARGS

tickets.description: Bootstrap tickets from feature-matrix.md — creates GitHub Issues for all unscoped work
tickets.template: Bootstrap tickets: read docs/features/feature-matrix.md, identify unscoped Phase 1 features, create GitHub Issues as epics and child tasks following the project-management skill conventions.

ticket-status.description: Show status of all open tickets
ticket-status.template: Show all open GitHub Issues with labels, status, and phase grouping.

ticket-next.template: Show the next unassigned Backlog ticket ordered by phase priority.
